verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken 320x50 layout. The legal disclaimer is blown up to the size of the body copy and fills the right third. The SOLSTICE wordmark sits under the headline instead of above it. The three flavour pills don't match in size, and the subline is too small to read. In A, the Blood Orange pill is jammed against the top edge, clipped and crowding the CTA, and the subline is crushed beneath the button. B is marginally less bad: its Blood Orange pill is tiny but sits cleanly under the CTA, though its subline is unreadable and jammed into the top-left corner.
